# homeassistant_input_button (Resource)

A button helper (`input_button`): a button that automations can react to when it is pressed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A button that automations can trigger on. The entity is input_button.doorbell.
resource "homeassistant_input_button" "doorbell" {
  name = "Doorbell"
  icon = "mdi:bell"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Changing it renames the helper in place.

### Optional

- `icon` (String) Icon, e.g. `mdi:toggle-switch`.
- `id` (String) Helper ID, a slug such as `guest_mode`. Home Assistant derives it from `name` when the helper is created, and keeps it when the helper is renamed. Set it to choose the ID yourself. Changing it replaces the helper. Creation fails if the ID is taken. Import with this ID.

### Read-Only

- `entity_id` (String) Entity ID of the helper, `input_button.<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an input_button helper by its ID.
tofu import homeassistant_input_button.doorbell doorbell
```
